done.title: Email confirmed
done.text: Thank you — the address now carries a verified badge on the map and in the company profile.

missing.title: The link is incomplete
missing.text: Open the link from the email again, or copy it into the browser in full.

invalid.title: This link is not valid
invalid.text: It may be mistyped or replaced by a newer one. Ask the company owner to send a new confirmation.

expired.title: The link has expired
expired.text: Confirmation links work for 24 hours. Open the point on the map and send a new confirmation.

stale.title: The email has changed
stale.text: This link was sent to an address the point no longer uses. Confirm the current address with a new link.

offline.title: Can’t reach Avalon
offline.text: Check your connection and try again.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.text: We could not confirm the email right now. Please try again.

home: Go to the Avalon home page
footer: Avalon Shipping · ship agency on the Lower Danube
